newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA FEB MONTHLY INFLATION HITS 45-MONTH HIGH.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA FEB MONTHLY INFLATION HITS 45-MONTH HIGH.

text.p: Romanian monthly inflation climbed to a 45-month high in February surging to 18.8 percent from 13.7 percent in January, National Statistics Board (CNS) data showed on Wednesday.
Year-on-year inflation soared to 105.4 percent last month from January's 76.3 percent, with a two-month consumer price increase of 35 percent.
The blip in inflation last month followed a mid-February move by Romania's new centrist coalition government to free fuel, energy and food prices.
Local economists said inflation was expected to stay high in the coming months under the impact of price liberalisation. Inflation was estimated at 41 percent for the first quarter of this year.
Official forecasts put the 1997 year-on-year inflation at 89.5 percent against 56.9 percent in 1996.
